description: The Senate in an overnight vote Saturday approved a short-term measure to fund federal agencies into early December and avoid a potentially chaotic government shutdown during the middle of campaign season. The late-summer action on a funding fix is unusual. Normally, Congress waits until the final days or hours of a funding deadline to pass short-term patches, but this time senators acted nearly two months before the end of the fiscal year on Sept. 30. title: Senate approves funding bill to avoid a shutdown before the election

description: President Volodymyr Zelensky was making his first official visit to Serbia -- a rare European country still closely aligned with Moscow -- on Saturday as Ukraine seeks to bolster international support in the face of intensifying Russian strikes. Zelensky was to hold talks with his counterpart Alexander Vucic at the presidential palace on Saturday, after another intense bombardment of Kyiv and the surrounding region overnight killed at least four people. title: Ukraine's Zelensky visits Russian ally Serbia as Moscow pounds Kyiv

description: Relatives of victims of the shooting at a high school and a home outside Bangkok retrieved the bodies of their loved ones Saturday, a day after the gunman killed at least seven people. A 14-year-old schoolboy opened fire at around 10 a.m. Friday at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi province northwest of Bangkok before taking his own life. title: Families retrieve bodies after a 14-year-old killed at least 7 in a shooting outside Bangkok

title: Lee vows to review policies that discourage young couples from registering marriage

description: At Korean convenience stores, the liquor aisle's most valuable real estate is changing hands. Eye-level shelves once dominated by 500-milliliter beer cans and green soju bottles are increasingly filled with colorful ready-to-drink cocktails and bottles of lower-alcohol flavored soju, as Koreans drink less and seek lighter options. title: As Korea drinks less, liquor goes lighter — and global

description: By Korean Food Promotion Institute Editor's note Jokbal is a Korean dish of pig's trotters slowly braised in a soy sauce seasoning with ginger, garlic and doenjang until the meat turns tender. It is prized for the silky, collagen-heavy texture that gives each bite its signature chew. The trotters are typically served cold or warm, sliced thinly and eaten in lettuce wraps or dipped in a salted shrimp sauce, and are a popular accompaniment to drinks. She trained as a concert pianist — achieving competition wins, going to the top of her class at Dankook University, then winning the Kumho Prize, one of Korea's most competitive classical prizes. The switch came almost by accident, during a piano master's program in Germany, when a required conducting class put a baton in her hand. title: A Korean conductor's first time on a Korean podium

description: The number of heat-related illness cases reported in late summer nearly tripled in the past 10 years, government data showed Saturday. An annual average of 215 heat-related patients were reported from "ipchu" to the end of August during the 2011-2015 period, according to an analysis by a research institute under the interior ministry using data from the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency. Ipchu, which falls on Aug. 7 this year, marks the beginning of autumn on the traditional calendar.
title: Heat-related illness patients in late summer up threefold over past decade: data

description: A bust honoring Kang Il-chul, who survived Japanese military sexual slavery and spent decades seeking justice for fellow victims, was unveiled Saturday at the House of Sharing in Gwangju, Gyeonggi Province. Kang, a prominent advocate for victims’ rights, died in March at age 98. Participants laid flowers before the bust and observed a moment of silence in tribute to her life and work. The unveiling was part of a ceremony held ahead of Aug. 14, South Korea’s national memorial day honoring victims
title: Survivor’s story, carried forward

description: The Korea Football Association formally apologized Saturday to football fans and officials and pledged sweeping reforms as controversies over its governance and alleged misconduct continued to mount. title: Embattled KFA apologizes, vows ‘sweeping reform’

description: The latest Spider-Man film surpassed 5 million ticket sales on the 11th day of its release in South Korea, the film's local distributor said Saturday. "Spider-Man: Brand New Day," the fourth installment starring Tom Holland, hit the 5 million mark Saturday morning, its local distributor, Sony Pictures, said. title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' exceeds 5 mln ticket sales in Korea

description: After a week of record-breaking heat, South Korea entered the weekend with little respite from extreme weather. title: Record heat loosens grip over weekend
